checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate assets: 4:5 poster, 9:16 story, 9:16 reel
must.why: Poster is 9:16 tall (352x640), not 4:5; the assistant called it 'vertical'. Three assets were delivered, but the poster ratio is wrong.

must.item: All three use warm lanterns and coordinated midnight blue and gold
must.why: All show glowing lanterns on a navy night sky with gold type and a riverside scene.

must.item: Each asset includes exact name, date, time, venue, free entry
must.why: Poster title reads 'LANTERN MIGHET'. The story has only a short date, and its venue and free-entry text is garbled. The reel has no text.

must.item: Reel runs 10 s with visible motion
must.why: The reel is 10 s, and the frames show a slow forward camera move with changing lantern positions. It is subtle but real.

must.item: Text legible and unclipped in both images; reel holds details
must.why: Poster title is misspelled. The story text is partly garbled ('YARD ·', 'ENTRY' overlapped) and the reel has no details at all.

exact_text.read_as: Poster: 'LANTERN MIGHET'. Story: 'LANTERN NIGHT MARKET' with a distorted N/I.
Poster: '18 SEPTEMBER 2027'. Story only has 'SEPT 18', with no year.
Poster: 'RIVERSIDE YARD' (correct). Story: 'RIVERSIDE YARD' with a clipped or garbled D.
Poster: 'FREE ENTRY' (correct). Story: 'FREE ENTRY' garbled and overlapped.

faults.what: Poster title misspelled as 'LANTERN MIGHET'. The assistant claimed the poster text was correct.
Story picture text is garbled. 'NIGHT' is distorted, and 'YARD' and 'ENTRY' are clipped or overlapped by artefacts.
The reel has no event text or details, so it does not meet the requirement to hold the event details on screen.
The poster is 9:16, not the 4:5 specified.
The reel motion is subtle, and the river looks flooded and wet like a street.

summary: The pack looks attractive and on-theme, but the poster title is misspelled 'MIGHET', the story text is garbled, the poster is not 4:5, and the reel carries no event text.
